objective: Eliminate every Ordivon-specific primitive unless mature external semantics cannot replace it losslessly.
residualCandidates: effect reconciliation for non-idempotent externally observed effects
semantic-completion binding across execution and domain verification
rule: No local concept survives because of code volume, historical compatibility, documentation, or branding. Migration cost is not architectural value.
stopCondition: Zero Ordivon-specific residue, or executable proof that each remaining primitive cannot be losslessly replaced by mature alternatives.
